lesson.title: Sector rotation
lesson.body: Money moves between sectors as the economy shifts. Falling interest rates tend to help tech and utilities; rising oil helps energy. The sector heat map shows where the money is going.

glossary: Momentum
How much a price has risen over recent months. Winners tend to keep winning for a while.
ATR
Average True Range: the size of a normal day's move, in dollars. Used to set stops and sizes.
Stop
A pre-set price where we sell to cap the damage if something goes badly wrong.
50-day / 200-day average
The average price over the last 50 / 200 trading days. Above = uptrend.
Beta
How much a stock usually moves when the S&P 500 moves 1%. Beta 1.5 = moves about 1.5%.
Rebalance
Bringing each part of the account back to its target share.
Sector ETF
One fund that holds a whole sector (e.g. XLE = US energy companies).
CDR
Canadian Depositary Receipt: a CAD-priced, currency-hedged version of a US stock on the Canadian exchange.
Drawdown
How far the account is below its highest value.
VIX
The market's 'fear gauge'. Below 20 is calm; above 28 is stressed.

analyst.text:
Midweek: the market light is still RED (VIX 31). Chips fell 7% this week after giving back Monday's Huang rally; renewed congressional scrutiny and rising rate-hike expectations weighed on them. Staples and consumer stocks are flat to slightly up.
AMD is -18% this week, about 12 points worse than the market. A resale filing for about 337M shares tied to OpenAI and Meta warrants is adding pressure; AMD receives no proceeds. Its business story is intact, and it is well above the 355.92 disaster stop.
NVDA is flat this week after the reinstatement swing.
The SNOW and CRWD sells still stand. The CRWD-Zscaler all-stock deal (announced Monday) adds dilution and regulatory risk.
US markets are closed Thursday for Thanksgiving, and Friday is a half day.
